notes: All update problems fixed in one release, plus a new app icon
patch_notes:
The update flow is rebuilt end to end: the app now restarts itself to finish an update (no manual close), the unattended build no longer stalls on a hidden pause, a build log is kept (update_build.log), and if a build ever fails the previous version relaunches instead of leaving you with nothing.
The freshly built exe is also copied back over the copy you launched, so taskbar pins and old shortcuts can no longer resurrect an old version.
New app icon: a violet ring with a cyan core on a dark tile. Copies still showing the generic old icon are outdated builds.
